title: To rename the Success Dam in Tulare County, California, as the Richard L. Schafer Dam.
official_summary: This bill designates the Success Dam in Tulare County, California, as the "Richard L. Schafer Dam."

summary.headline: A 2019 law renamed the Success Dam in Tulare County, California, as the Richard L. Schafer Dam.
summary.what_it_does: This law changes the official name of the Success Dam in Tulare County, California, to the Richard L. Schafer Dam. It does not change how the dam is run, funded, or maintained. The summary does not describe any other effects.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on August 9, 2019.
